title: causalbase: Bayesian network structure learning and causal discovery
description: A Python library for learning the structure of Bayesian networks, and the causal structure behind them, from data held in one place. It implements Greedy Equivalence Search (GES) and Extremely Greedy Equivalence Search (XGES) over BDeu, BIC or Gaussian BIC; iterated local search over variable orders polished by GES or XGES; FLOP; hill climbing and tabu search over DAGs; and exact search by dynamic programming or, under a parent limit, integer programming. The scores and the graph routines run in compiled code. It also provides structural metrics, XMLBIF input, forward sampling and five bundled benchmark networks. The federated methods of fedcausal build on it.
